{{Top|leg}} {{Otheruses|unidentified bounty hunter}} {{Conjecture|legends}} {{Character |type=Bounty hunter |image= |name=Unidentified bounty hunter |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species= |gender= |pronouns= |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes= |skin= |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings=A [[Unidentified bounty hunter's brother|brother]][[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']] |children= |affiliation= |masters= |apprentices= }} A '''bounty hunter''' operated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During one adventure, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] had to rescue a [[Unidentified child (Dantooine)|child]] who wrestled a [[Unidentified pirate (Dantooine)|pirate]] out of a hatch. Using a [[Parachute/Legends|parachute]] and an [[ablative heatshield]], the hunter dove from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] to the surface to save the [[Youngling/Legends|kid]]. They parted ways sometime after. Later, while on the [[Methane/Legends|methane]] planet [[Farstine]], the hunter encountered another [[Unidentified child (Farstine)|child]]. Orphaned, homeless, and penniless, the child was down to his last fifteen [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] of [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]. The hunter, reminded of a [[Unidentified bounty hunter's brother|brother]] who had died young, took the child under their protection. The bounty hunter possessed an outwardly rough disposition that shielded a compassionate nature. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|You sure this isn't too melodramatic?''"
"''No, sounds good to me. Besides, melodrama is easy to roleplay.|Two fictitious players discuss the bounty hunter's backstory|}} The bounty hunter was first mentioned in [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']], released in [[1987]]. The individual is used in a hypothetical discussion between fictitious players as example for how to connect characters' backstories. ==Sources== *[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']] {{1stm}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Bounty hunters]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
